scripts.test: node --test tools/data/*.test.mjs tools/app/*.test.mjs packages/engine/test/*.test.mjs app/src/storage/*.test.mjs app/src/model/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run data:check-import && npm run app:prepare && npm run typecheck && npm run app:typecheck && npm test
scripts.app:start: npm run app:prepare && npm --workspace app start
scripts.app:web: npm run app:prepare && npm --workspace app run web
scripts.app:android: npm run app:prepare && npm --workspace app run android
scripts.app:export: npm run app:prepare && npm --workspace app run export
